name: com.dronebundle/airspace
title: DroneBundle Airspace
description: Can I fly my drone here? Free airspace check for the US and Europe: no-fly zones, LAANC, TFRs.

tools.name: check_airspace
tools.description: Whether a drone can fly at a spot, from DroneBundle's airspace map: the verdict (no-fly, authorization needed, caution or clear), the altitude limit, the permission to ask for (such as LAANC), every drone zone at the spot (airspace, TFRs, NOTAMs, parks and national drone zones) and the airports, obstacles and power lines nearby. Covers the US, the UK, Australia and 20 European countries. Give lat and lng, or a place name or address as place. Add at, a time up to 30 days ahead (local time at the spot unless it has an offset), to check a planned flight.

place.description: A place name or address to look up instead of lat and lng, such as "Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco".

at.description: When the flight is planned, from 24 hours ago to 30 days ahead. ISO 8601: without an offset (2026-11-28T15:00) it is local time at the spot, with one (2026-11-28T15:00:00-08:00) it is exact, and a date alone means noon local time. Leave out to check now.
